info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/wan-22-vace-fun-a14b/outpainting
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/wan-22-vace-fun-a14b/outpainting queue.

ref_image_urls.title: Reference Image URLs
ref_image_urls.description: URLs to source reference image. If provided, the model will use this image as reference.

acceleration.title: Acceleration
acceleration.description: Acceleration to use for inference. Options are 'none' or 'regular'. Accelerated inference will very slightly affect output, but will be significantly faster.

video_write_mode.title: Video Write Mode
video_write_mode.description: The write mode of the generated video.

expand_bottom.description: Whether to expand the video to the bottom.
expand_bottom.title: Expand Bottom

frames_per_second.title: Frames per Second
frames_per_second.description: Frames per second of the generated video. Must be between 5 to 30. Ignored if match_input_frames_per_second is true.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

match_input_num_frames.title: Match Input Number of Frames
match_input_num_frames.description: If true, the number of frames in the generated video will match the number of frames in the input video. If false, the number of frames will be determined by the num_frames parameter.

num_frames.title: Number of Frames
num_frames.description: Number of frames to generate. Must be between 81 to 241 (inclusive).

expand_top.description: Whether to expand the video to the top.
expand_top.title: Expand Top

return_frames_zip.title: Return Frames Zip
return_frames_zip.description: If true, also return a ZIP file containing all generated frames.

enable_auto_downsample.title: Enable Auto Downsample
enable_auto_downsample.description: If true, the model will automatically temporally downsample the video to an appropriate frame length for the model, then will interpolate it back to the original frame length.

examples: A lone woman strides through the neon-drenched streets of Tokyo at night.  Her crimson dress, a vibrant splash of color against the deep blues and blacks of the cityscape, flows slightly with each step. A tailored black jacket, crisp and elegant, contrasts sharply with the dress's rich texture. Medium shot:  The city hums around her, blurred lights creating streaks of color in the background. Close-up:  The fabric of her dress catches the streetlight's glow, revealing a subtle silk sheen and the intricate stitching at the hem. Her black jacket’s subtle texture is visible – a fine wool perhaps, with a matte finish. The overall mood is one of quiet confidence and mystery, a vibrant woman navigating a bustling, nocturnal landscape. High resolution 4k.
prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The text prompt to guide video generation.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

expand_left.description: Whether to expand the video to the left.
expand_left.title: Expand Left

interpolator_model.title: Interpolator Model
interpolator_model.description: The model to use for frame interpolation. Options are 'rife' or 'film'.

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video.

transparency_mode.title: Transparency Mode
transparency_mode.description: The transparency mode to apply to the first and last frames. This controls how the transparent areas of the first and last frames are filled.

sampler.title: Sampler
sampler.description: Sampler to use for video generation.

auto_downsample_min_fps.description: The minimum frames per second to downsample the video to. This is used to help determine the auto downsample factor to try and find the lowest detail-preserving downsample factor. The default value is appropriate for most videos, if you are using a video with very fast motion, you may need to increase this value. If your video has a very low amount of motion, you could decrease this value to allow for higher downsampling and thus longer sequences.
auto_downsample_min_fps.title: Auto Downsample Min FPS

expand_right.description: Whether to expand the video to the right.
expand_right.title: Expand Right

num_interpolated_frames.description: Number of frames to interpolate between the original frames. A value of 0 means no interpolation.
num_interpolated_frames.title: Number of Interpolated Frames

num_inference_steps.title: Number of Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: Number of inference steps for sampling. Higher values give better quality but take longer.

video_url.title: Video URL
video_url.description: URL to the source video file. Required for outpainting.

first_frame_url.title: First Frame URL
first_frame_url.description: URL to the first frame of the video. If provided, the model will use this frame as a reference.

last_frame_url.title: Last Frame URL
last_frame_url.description: URL to the last frame of the video. If provided, the model will use this frame as a reference.

expand_ratio.description: Amount of expansion. This is a float value between 0 and 1, where 0.25 adds 25% to the original video size on the specified sides.
expand_ratio.title: Expand Ratio

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

temporal_downsample_factor.description: Temporal downsample factor for the video. This is an integer value that determines how many frames to skip in the video. A value of 0 means no downsampling. For each downsample factor, one upsample factor will automatically be applied.
temporal_downsample_factor.title: Temporal Downsample Factor

video_quality.title: Video Quality
video_quality.description: The quality of the generated video.

match_input_frames_per_second.title: Match Input Frames Per Second
match_input_frames_per_second.description: If true, the frames per second of the generated video will match the input video. If false, the frames per second will be determined by the frames_per_second parameter.

guidance_scale.description: Guidance scale for classifier-free guidance. Higher values encourage the model to generate images closely related to the text prompt.
guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
